Hi there! I'm Farah Stack, a climate justice advocate and environmental data scientist in training at the Bren School at UC Santa Barbara.

I’m interested in using data to bridge science, policy, and community knowledge—advancing environmental justice, climate resilience, and a healthier planet for people and the places we love.
